mapper.select: SELECT p.document_id,p.document_version AS version,p.index_generation,p.job_id,p.processor_version,p.batch_digest, p.content_hash AS source_hash,r.display_name AS title,r.content_type,r.size_bytes,r.source_bucket,r.source_key FROM knowledge_ingestion j JOIN knowledge_ingestion p ON p.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND p.owner_id=j.owner_id AND p.document_id=j.document_id AND p.job_id=j.base_published_job_id AND p.document_version=j.base_published_version AND p.index_generation=j.base_published_generation JOIN knowledge_document_revision r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id AND r.document_id=p.document_id AND r.content_revision=p.document_version AND r.content_hash=p.content_hash AND r.content_type=p.content_type AND r.size_bytes=p.size_bytes WHERE j.tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND j.owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND j.job_id=#{jobId} AND p.status='READY' AND p.batch_digest IS NOT NULL

SELECT compensation_id,tenant_id,owner_id,candidate_id,source_approval_id,approved_revision,source_publication_json, created_revision,command_id,note,created_at FROM knowledge_candidate_compensation WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND candidate_id=#{id} AND (approved_revision=#{revision} OR created_revision=#{revision}) ORDER BY created_revision DESC LIMIT 2
